entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can use a creature’s diseased state against it.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): When you hit a diseased creature with a weapon attack, you deal an additional 1d6 points of damage. This is precision damage. Additionally, you gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks against diseased creatures.
